source_binding.comparison: Frozen and merged source routine definitions were checked directly; persisted divergence and operator coefficients are not builder inputs.
source_binding.construction: Rebuild lateral pressure-overlap segments, pressure-center vertical weights, shared-face fluxes and perimeter/top/bottom terms from retained geometry and state fields. State dry-air mass measure divided by pressure mass measure and state winds are the independent flux inputs. Persisted divergence is read only after construction as a comparison target; no persisted operator coefficients are read.
source_binding.geostrophic_stencil: On each requested fixed-mask cell: require above-ground and usable finite pressure/U/V; select the forward x/y neighbor if usable, else backward; then require geopotential valid, quality outside the excluded bits 0b111, and positive source at center and both selected neighbors. RMS is sqrt(sum(ru^2+rv^2)/(2*N)).
independent_builder_inputs: top/bottom omega boundary values and validity
source_binding.metadata_limit: Retained NetCDF exports geopotential valid/quality/source arrays but does not export pressure/U/V valid/quality/source arrays; independent reconstruction uses retained pressure/U/V numeric values plus above_ground for pressure/U/V usability. The Fortran source routine checks their state masks. The fixed mask had full 900/900 stencil coverage for OFF, HYDRO, and COUPLED, so no rows were dropped.
source_binding.operator_diff: Direct comparison of the frozen producer source (revision 08e2ae0, SHA-256 31a1975b07c629e276efd23bc0fe173cd4366bd7d080c645049a5ed6903de156) and merged comparison revision 3d2bf4c showed the six bound routine definitions byte-identical. The new Python analysis edits no Fortran source.
source_binding.persisted_arrays_policy: Persisted divergence and candidate force arrays are not inputs to independently constructed dry flux; persisted divergence is read only after the builder returns as a comparison target. No saved operator coefficients are read.

source_math.boundary_signs: At x/y minima the perimeter flux is negative outward-normal coordinate flux; maxima are positive. Top omega boundary is negative and bottom omega boundary positive in the vertical divergence, with boundary dry fraction taken from adjacent cell.
source_math.cell_force: r_u = -f*v + dPhi/dx; r_v = f*u + dPhi/dy. Candidate-minus-OFF exactly separates into (d/dx,d/dy) delta-Phi plus (-f*delta-v, f*delta-u). RMS is sqrt(sum(ru^2+rv^2)/(2*N)).
source_math.horizontal_shared_face: F_x = 0.5*(dy_L+dy_R)*Delta_p/g * (dx_R/(dx_L+dx_R)*u_L*Md_L/Mp_L + dx_L/(dx_L+dx_R)*u_R*Md_R/Mp_R); the y face is analogous with x width and v. Retained dx/dy are uniform to source contract tolerance, so these weights reduce to 1/2.
source_math.vertical_shared_face: F_p = dx*dy/g * (p_L-interface - p_center_R)/(p_center_L-p_center_R)*omega_L*Md_L/Mp_L + complementary pressure-center weight times omega_R*Md_R/Mp_R.
